headline: Approved a special permit for a wall sign at 34 Chapin Terrace; continued 500 Page Boulevard liquor license to August 19, 2026.
summary: The board granted a special permit for one accessory wall sign at 34 Chapin Terrace, with conditions, by a 7-0 vote. It also continued a beer and wine package store liquor license request for 500 Page Boulevard to August 19, 2026, by a 7-0 vote.
decisions: Continued the beer and wine liquor license (package store) request for 500 Page Boulevard to the August 19, 2026 meeting, 7-0.
Approved the special permit for one accessory wall sign in a location not otherwise permitted at 34 Chapin Terrace, with conditions, 7-0.

plain_text:
ROLL CALL:  
 
Present: seven (7): Mr. Florian, Ms. Morin, Mr. Daniele, Ms. McQuade, Mr. Cunningham, 
Mr. Mineo and Ms. Ford  
Absent: zero (0)  
 
PUBLIC HEARING :  
 
Liquor License:  
 
1. Beer & Wine Liquor License (Package Store)  
Location: 500 Page Boulevard  
Petitioner: Shaili Love, Inc. – d/b/a Page Convenience  
 
SPEAKING IN FAVOR: ZERO (0) 
SPEAKING AGAINST: ZERO (0)  
 
MOTION: CONTINUE, UNIT THE AUGUST 19, 2026 MEETING. 
 
IN FAVOR: seven (7): Mr. Florian, Ms. Morin, Mr. Daniele, Ms. McQuade, Mr. 
Cunningham, Mr. Mineo and Ms. Ford 
OPPOSED: zero (0)  
ABSTAINED:  N/A  
RECOMMENDATION: Continued until the August 19, 20206 meeting. 
 
Special Permit:  
 
1. Accessory Wall Sign (In a location not otherwise permitted)  
Location: 34 Chapin Terrace  
MEETING MINUTES SUMMARY  
Date:  July 15, 2026 
Time:   6:00PM  
Location:  36 Court Street, Room 220, City Hall
Petitioner: RMHC CTMA (Ronald McDonald House)  
 
SPEAKING IN FAVOR: ONE (1)  
SPEAKING AGAINST: ZERO (0)  
 
MOTION: Approve, with conditions.  
 
1. This special permit is granted to this petitioner only. 
2. This special permit is granted solely for the installation of one (1), accessory wall sign, 
in a location not otherwise permitted, at the property known as 34 Chapin Terrace 
(02640-0006).  
3. The use shall be developed in accordance to the attached plans and elevations, 
with the addition of conditions #4 and #5.  
4. The sign shall not be internally illuminated.  
5. A sign permit shall be obtained through the Building Department, prior to installation. 
6. The Planning Board shall have the authority to modify, amend, review or revoke its 
approval of a special permit upon written application of the owner, lessee or Zoning 
Administrator; provided, however, that such action is consistent with the purpose 
and intent of the Springfield Zoning Ordinance and a public hearing is held.  
7. Compliance with these conditions, as well as any and all zoning regulations, is 
required.  Failure to comply may result in denial of the issuance of a Sign/Building 
Permit and/or Occupancy Permit, revocation of any permits issued and/or 
enforcement by the Code Enforcement Department punishable by fines of up to 
$200 per day for each day a violation exists.  
 
 
Approval Criteria: (Article 9, Section 9.12.21) 
 
1. The sign is consistent with the intent and purpose of Article 9.  
2. The sign is consistent with the character and use of the area and with the Zoning 
District in which it is erected.  
3. The sign is appropriate in scale and proportion in its design and in its visual 
relationship to buildings in the area and its general surrounding.  
4. The Planning staff analysis shall be incorporated into the decision as one of the basis 
for approval.  
 
IN FAVOR: seven (7): Mr. Florian, Ms. Morin, Mr. Daniele, Ms. McQuade, Mr. 
Cunningham, Mr. Mineo and Ms. Ford 
OPPOSED: zero (0)  
ABSTAINED:  N/A  
RECOMMENDATION: APPROVE  
 
 
ALL OTHER MATTERS PROP ERLY  BEFORE THE BOARD
